title: 'Minas Gerais: Dengue and Chikungunya'
subtitle: Pooled municipal analysis, 2021–2025
output:
  html_document: default

# Setup

```{r setup}
library(geobr)
library(sf)
library(INLA)
library(combinat)
library(leaflet)
library(ggplot2)
years <- 2021:2025
diseases <- c("dengue", "chikungunya")
path <- "."
unzip("inputs.zip", exdir = path)

dir.create(file.path(path, "data/raw"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(path, "data/processed"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

# Municipalities

```{r municipalities}
file <- file.path(path, "data/raw/boundaries.rds")
if (!file.exists(file)) {
  map <- read_municipality(code_muni = 31, year = 2020)
  saveRDS(map, file)
}

map <- readRDS(file)
codes <- as.character(map$code_muni)
length(codes)
```

# Weekly reported cases

```{r weekly-cases}
options(timeout = 300)
weekly <- data.frame()

for (code in codes) {
  for (disease in diseases) {
    file <- file.path(path, "data/raw",
                      paste0(code, "_", disease, "_2021_2025.csv"))
    url <- paste0("https://info.dengue.mat.br/api/alertcity?geocode=", code,
                  "&disease=", disease,
                  "&format=csv&ew_start=1&ew_end=53&ey_start=2021&ey_end=2025")

    if (!file.exists(file)) download.file(url, file, mode = "wb", quiet = TRUE)
    x <- read.csv(file)

    weekly <- rbind(weekly, data.frame(
      code = code, disease = disease,
      year = x$SE %/% 100, week = x$SE %% 100, cases = x$casos
    ))
  }
}
```

# Annual and pooled counts

```{r annual-counts}
annual <- aggregate(cases ~ code + disease + year, weekly,
                    sum, na.action = na.pass)
weeks <- aggregate(week ~ code + disease + year, weekly, length)
annual <- merge(annual, weeks)
annual <- merge(expand.grid(code = codes, disease = diseases, year = years),
                annual, all.x = TRUE)

annual$cases[is.na(annual$week) |
               annual$week != ifelse(annual$year == 2025, 53, 52)] <- NA
names(annual)[names(annual) == "week"] <- "weeks_received"

write.csv(annual, file.path(path, "data/processed/annual_cases.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r pooled-counts}
pooled <- aggregate(cases ~ code + disease, annual,
                    sum, na.action = na.pass)
write.csv(pooled, file.path(path, "data/processed/pooled_cases.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

counts <- data.frame()
for (disease in diseases) {
  x <- pooled$cases[pooled$disease == disease]
  counts <- rbind(counts, data.frame(
    disease = disease,
    complete = sum(!is.na(x)),
    missing = sum(is.na(x)),
    zero = sum(x == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    positive = sum(x > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    zero_percent = 100 * sum(x == 0, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(!is.na(x)),
    total_cases = sum(x)
  ))
}
counts
```

# Annual disease burden

```{r annual-disease-burden}
burden <- aggregate(cases ~ year + disease, annual, sum, na.action = na.pass)
burden <- reshape(burden, idvar = "year", timevar = "disease", direction = "wide")
burden <- burden[order(burden$year), ]

matplot(burden$year, burden[c("cases.dengue", "cases.chikungunya")],
        type = "l", xlab = "Year", ylab = "Reported cases")
legend("topleft", legend = c("Dengue", "Chikungunya"), col = 1:2, lty = 1:2)

```

# Expected counts and SIRs

```{r population}
population <- read.csv2(file.path(path, "data/raw/population_tabnet.csv"),
                        na.strings = "-", fileEncoding = "UTF-8")
population$code <- codes[match(substr(population[[1]], 1, 6), substr(codes, 1, 6))]
population <- population[!is.na(population$code), ]
population$person_years <- rowSums(population[paste0("X", years)])
population <- population[c("code", "person_years")]
```

```{r expected-counts-sir}
rates <- aggregate(cases ~ disease, pooled, sum, na.action = na.pass)
rates$rate <- rates$cases / sum(population$person_years)

sir <- merge(pooled, population, by = "code", all.x = TRUE)
sir$E <- sir$person_years * rates$rate[match(sir$disease, rates$disease)]
sir$SIR <- sir$cases / sir$E
sir$municipality <- map$name_muni[match(sir$code, codes)]
sir <- sir[c("code", "municipality", "disease", "cases", "person_years", "E", "SIR")]

write.csv(sir, file.path(path, "data/processed/expected_counts_SIR.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
```

# Shared map style

```{r map-display}
library(leaflet)
maps_dir <- file.path(path, "results/maps")
dir.create(maps_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
map_web <- st_transform(map, 4326)
bounds <- st_bbox(map_web)
risk_breaks <- c(0, 0.3, 0.6, 0.9, 1.1, 1.5, 2, 5, 10, Inf)
risk_labels <- c("0 to <0.3", "0.3 to <0.6", "0.6 to <0.9", "0.9 to <1.1",
                 "1.1 to <1.5", "1.5 to <2", "2 to <5", "5 to <10", ">=10")
risk_colors <- c("#294563", "#5985AE", "#A4CCE5", "#F7F7F7", "#F4A582",
                 "#E45A4F", "#B62828", "#8D1C24", "#5D191A")
risk_palette <- colorBin(risk_colors, bins = risk_breaks, right = FALSE, na.color = "#999999")
map_css <- htmltools::tags$style(htmltools::HTML(
  ".info.legend {font: 20px/26px Arial; padding: 12px; color: #222;}
   .info.legend i {width: 22px; height: 24px; margin-right: 8px;}
   .leaflet-control-scale-line {font-size: 15px; line-height: 18px;}
   .leaflet-control-attribution {font-size: 12px;}"))
```

## SIR maps

```{r sir-map}
sir_maps <- list()
for (disease in diseases) {
  x <- map_web
  rows <- sir[sir$disease == disease, ]
  x$value <- rows$SIR[match(codes, rows$code)]
  p <- leaflet(x, width = 1200, height = 1000,
    options = leafletOptions(zoomControl = FALSE, zoomSnap = 0.1)) |>
    addTiles() |>
    fitBounds(bounds[["xmin"]] - 0.3, bounds[["ymin"]] - 0.3,
              bounds[["xmax"]] + 1.5, bounds[["ymax"]] + 0.3) |>
    addPolygons(fillColor = ~risk_palette(value), fillOpacity = 0.95,
      color = "white", weight = 0.5, opacity = 0.7,
      label = ~paste0(name_muni, ": SIR = ", round(value, 2))) |>
    addLegend(position = "bottomright", colors = risk_colors, labels = risk_labels,
      opacity = 0.95, title = "SIR") |>
    addControl(paste0("<b style='font-size:26px'>", tools::toTitleCase(disease),
      "</b><br>SIR | Minas Gerais, 2021-2025"), position = "topleft") |>
    addScaleBar(position = "bottomleft", options = scaleBarOptions(imperial = FALSE))
  p <- htmlwidgets::prependContent(p, map_css)
  sir_maps[[disease]] <- p
  htmlwidgets::saveWidget(p, file.path(maps_dir, paste0("SIR_", disease, "_osm.html")),
                         selfcontained = FALSE, libdir = "leaflet_libs")
}
htmltools::tagList(sir_maps)
```

# Temperature and relative humidity availability

```{r climate-data}
library(ggplot2)

fields <- c("tempmin", "tempmed", "tempmax", "umidmin", "umidmed", "umidmax")
climate <- data.frame()

for (code in sort(codes)) {
  x <- read.csv(file.path(path, "data/raw", paste0(code, "_dengue_2021_2025.csv")))
  climate <- rbind(climate, data.frame(code = code, date = as.Date(x$data_iniSE),
                                      year = x$SE %/% 100, x[fields]))
}

climate <- reshape(climate, varying = fields, v.names = "value",
                   timevar = "variable", times = fields,
                   idvar = c("code", "date"), direction = "long")
climate$available <- is.finite(climate$value)
climate$variable <- factor(climate$variable, levels = fields,
                           labels = c("Minimum temperature", "Mean temperature", "Maximum temperature",
                                      "Minimum relative humidity", "Mean relative humidity", "Maximum relative humidity"))
```

```{r climate-yearly-coverage}
climate_years <- aggregate(available ~ year + code + variable, climate, sum)
names(climate_years)[2] <- "municipality_code"
climate_years$completeness <- climate_years$available /
  ifelse(climate_years$year == 2025, 53, 52)
period <- "2021–2025"
```

```{r climate-availability, fig.width=12, fig.height=8, dpi=150}
p <- ggplot(climate_years, aes(factor(year), municipality_code, fill = completeness)) +
  geom_tile() + facet_wrap(~variable, ncol = 3) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(limits = c(0, 1), na.value = "grey85") +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Municipality", fill = "Weekly coverage",
       title = paste("Climate availability,", period)) +
  theme_minimal() + theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(), panel.grid = element_blank())
print(p)
ggsave(file.path(path, "climate_availability.png"), p, width = 12, height = 8)
```

# Rainfall, municipal HDI, vegetation, water piping, sewage, waste, and rurality

```{r rainfall-hdi-import}
rain <- read.csv(file.path(path, "data/raw/Sertao_Pluvial_Dados-3.csv"),
                 fileEncoding = "UTF-8-BOM", check.names = FALSE)
rain <- rain[rain$UF == "MG", ]
names(rain)[1] <- "municipality"
months <- c("Jan", "Fev", "Mar", "Abr", "Mai", "Jun",
            "Jul", "Ago", "Set", "Out", "Nov", "Dez")
for (month in months) {
  rain[[month]] <- as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", gsub(".", "", rain[[month]], fixed = TRUE),
                                   fixed = TRUE))
}
rain$rainfall_mm <- rowSums(rain[months])

hdi <- as.data.frame(readxl::read_excel(file.path(path, "data/raw/data-3.xlsx")))
names(hdi) <- c("municipality", "idhm_2010")
hdi <- hdi[grepl(" (MG)", hdi$municipality, fixed = TRUE), ]
hdi$municipality <- sub(" (MG)", "", hdi$municipality, fixed = TRUE)

vegetation <- as.data.frame(readxl::read_excel(file.path(path, "data/raw/data-6.xlsx")))
names(vegetation) <- c("municipality", "vegetation_2017")
vegetation <- vegetation[grepl(" (MG)", vegetation$municipality, fixed = TRUE), ]
vegetation$municipality <- sub(" (MG)", "", vegetation$municipality, fixed = TRUE)

water <- read.csv2(file.path(path, "data/raw/tabela6804.csv"), skip = 5,
                   header = FALSE, fill = TRUE,
                   col.names = c("municipality", "piping", "no_piped_water_2022"))
water <- water[grepl(" (MG)", water$municipality, fixed = TRUE) &
                 water$piping == "Sem água canalizada", ]
water$municipality <- sub(" (MG)", "", water$municipality, fixed = TRUE)
water$municipality[water$municipality == "Barão do Monte Alto"] <- "Barão de Monte Alto"
water$municipality[water$municipality == "Olhos-d'Água"] <- "Olhos-D'água"
water$no_piped_water_2022[water$no_piped_water_2022 == "-"] <- "0"
water$no_piped_water_2022 <- as.numeric(sub(",", ".", water$no_piped_water_2022, fixed = TRUE))

sewage <- as.data.frame(readxl::read_excel(file.path(path, "data/raw/tabela6805.xlsx"),
  sheet = "Tabela", skip = 5, col_names = c("municipality", "connected_pct")))
sewage <- sewage[grepl(" (MG)", sewage$municipality, fixed = TRUE), ]
sewage$municipality <- sub(" (MG)", "", sewage$municipality, fixed = TRUE)
sewage$municipality[sewage$municipality == "Barão do Monte Alto"] <- "Barão de Monte Alto"
sewage$municipality[sewage$municipality == "Olhos-d'Água"] <- "Olhos-D'água"
sewage$no_sewer_2022 <- 100 - as.numeric(sewage$connected_pct)

waste <- as.data.frame(readxl::read_excel(file.path(path, "data/raw/tabela6892.xlsx"),
  sheet = "Tabela", skip = 5, col_names = c("municipality", "collected_pct")))
waste <- waste[grepl(" (MG)", waste$municipality, fixed = TRUE), ]
waste$municipality <- sub(" (MG)", "", waste$municipality, fixed = TRUE)
waste$municipality[waste$municipality == "Barão do Monte Alto"] <- "Barão de Monte Alto"
waste$municipality[waste$municipality == "Olhos-d'Água"] <- "Olhos-D'água"
waste$no_waste_collection_2022 <- 100 - as.numeric(waste$collected_pct)

rural <- as.data.frame(readxl::read_excel(file.path(path, "data/raw/tabela9923.xlsx"),
  sheet = "Tabela", range = "A6:B860", col_names = c("municipality", "rural_pct_2022")))
rural <- rural[grepl(" (MG)", rural$municipality, fixed = TRUE), ]
rural$municipality <- sub(" (MG)", "", rural$municipality, fixed = TRUE)
rural$municipality[rural$municipality == "Barão do Monte Alto"] <- "Barão de Monte Alto"
rural$municipality[rural$municipality == "Olhos-d'Água"] <- "Olhos-D'água"
rural$rural_pct_2022[rural$rural_pct_2022 == "-"] <- "0"
rural$rural_pct_2022 <- as.numeric(rural$rural_pct_2022)
```

```{r rainfall-hdi-municipalities}
old <- c("Brasópolis", "Dona Eusébia", "Olhos d'Água", "Olhos-D'Água",
         "Passa-Vinte", "Pingo-d'Água", "Pingo-D'Água", "São João Del Rei",
         "São Thomé das Letras")
new <- c("Brazópolis", "Dona Euzébia", "Olhos-D'água", "Olhos-D'água",
         "Passa Vinte", "Pingo-D'água", "Pingo-D'água", "São João del Rei",
         "São Tomé das Letras")
for (i in seq_along(old)) {
  rain$municipality[rain$municipality == old[i]] <- new[i]
  hdi$municipality[hdi$municipality == old[i]] <- new[i]
  vegetation$municipality[vegetation$municipality == old[i]] <- new[i]
  water$municipality[water$municipality == old[i]] <- new[i]
  sewage$municipality[sewage$municipality == old[i]] <- new[i]
  waste$municipality[waste$municipality == old[i]] <- new[i]
  rural$municipality[rural$municipality == old[i]] <- new[i]
}

covariates <- data.frame(code = codes, municipality = map$name_muni)
covariates$rainfall_mm <- rain$rainfall_mm[match(covariates$municipality, rain$municipality)]
covariates$idhm_2010 <- hdi$idhm_2010[match(covariates$municipality, hdi$municipality)]
covariates$vegetation_2017 <- vegetation$vegetation_2017[
  match(covariates$municipality, vegetation$municipality)]
covariates$no_piped_water_2022 <- water$no_piped_water_2022[
  match(covariates$municipality, water$municipality)]
covariates$no_sewer_2022 <- sewage$no_sewer_2022[
  match(covariates$municipality, sewage$municipality)]
covariates$no_waste_collection_2022 <- waste$no_waste_collection_2022[
  match(covariates$municipality, waste$municipality)]
covariates$rural_pct_2022 <- rural$rural_pct_2022[
  match(covariates$municipality, rural$municipality)]
write.csv(covariates, file.path(path, "data/processed/rainfall_hdi.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

# Population density

```{r population-density}
covariates$area_km2 <- as.numeric(st_area(st_transform(map,
  "+proj=laea +lat_0=-19 +lon_0=-44 +datum=WGS84 +units=m +no_defs"))) / 1e6
covariates$mean_population <- population$person_years[match(covariates$code, population$code)] /
  length(years)
covariates$population_density <- covariates$mean_population / covariates$area_km2
covariates$log_population_density <- log(covariates$population_density)

```

# Complete the covariate dataset

```{r selected-climate-covariates}
temp <- aggregate(value ~ code,
                  climate[climate$variable == "Minimum temperature" & climate$available, ], mean)
humidity <- aggregate(value ~ code,
                      climate[climate$variable == "Maximum relative humidity" & climate$available, ], mean)
covariates$tempmin_mean <- temp$value[match(covariates$code, temp$code)]
covariates$umidmax_mean <- humidity$value[match(covariates$code, humidity$code)]

variables <- c("tempmin_mean", "umidmax_mean", "log_population_density", "rainfall_mm",
               "idhm_2010", "vegetation_2017", "no_piped_water_2022", "no_sewer_2022",
               "no_waste_collection_2022", "rural_pct_2022")
write.csv(covariates, file.path(path, "data/processed/covariates.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

# Covariate maps

```{r covariate-maps}
labels <- c("Minimum temperature, 2021–2025", "Maximum relative humidity, 2021–2025",
            "Log population density, 2021–2025", "Rainfall", "Municipal HDI, 2010",
            "Natural vegetation cover, 2017", "Households without piped water, 2022",
            "Households without general/stormwater network connection, 2022",
            "Households without waste collection, 2022", "Rural population, 2022")
units <- c("°C", "%", "ln(residents/km²)", "mm", "IDHM (0–1)", "%", "%", "%", "%", "%")
covariate_maps <- list()
for (j in seq_along(variables)) {
  x <- map_web
  x$value <- covariates[[variables[j]]][match(codes, covariates$code)]
  palette <- colorBin(risk_colors, domain = x$value, bins = 9,
                      pretty = FALSE, right = FALSE, na.color = "#999999")
  p <- leaflet(x, width = 1200, height = 1000,
    options = leafletOptions(zoomControl = FALSE, zoomSnap = 0.1)) |>
    addTiles() |>
    fitBounds(bounds[["xmin"]] - 0.3, bounds[["ymin"]] - 0.3,
              bounds[["xmax"]] + 1.5, bounds[["ymax"]] + 0.3) |>
    addPolygons(fillColor = ~palette(value), fillOpacity = 0.95,
      color = "white", weight = 0.5, opacity = 0.7,
      label = ~paste0(name_muni, ": ", round(value, 3))) |>
    addLegend(position = "bottomright", pal = palette, values = ~value,
      opacity = 0.95, title = units[j]) |>
    addControl(paste0("<b style='font-size:26px'>", labels[j],
      "</b><br>Minas Gerais"), position = "topleft") |>
    addScaleBar(position = "bottomleft", options = scaleBarOptions(imperial = FALSE))
  p <- htmlwidgets::prependContent(p, map_css)
  covariate_maps[[j]] <- p
  htmlwidgets::saveWidget(p, file.path(maps_dir, paste0(variables[j], "_osm.html")),
                         selfcontained = FALSE, libdir = "leaflet_libs")
}
summary(covariates)
htmltools::tagList(covariate_maps)
```

# Covariate correlation heatmap

```{r covariate-correlations, fig.width=16, fig.height=9}
values <- covariates[variables]
names(values) <- c("Minimum\ntemperature", "Maximum\nhumidity", "Log population\ndensity",
                   "Rainfall", "IDHM 2010", "Vegetation\n2017", "No piped water\n2022",
                   "No sewer network\n2022", "No waste collection\n2022", "Rural population\n2022")
n <- crossprod(!is.na(as.matrix(values)))
correlations <- data.frame()

for (method in c("pearson", "spearman")) {
  x <- as.data.frame(as.table(cor(values, use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = method)))
  names(x) <- c("variable_1", "variable_2", "correlation")
  x$n <- as.vector(n)
  x$method <- method
  correlations <- rbind(correlations, x)
}
correlations$method <- factor(correlations$method, levels = c("pearson", "spearman"),
                              labels = c("Pearson", "Spearman"))
correlations$variable_2 <- factor(correlations$variable_2, levels = rev(names(values)))

plot_data <- correlations[match(correlations$variable_2, names(values)) >
                            match(correlations$variable_1, names(values)), ]

p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(variable_1, variable_2, fill = correlation)) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", correlation)), size = 3) +
  scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166AC", mid = "white", high = "#B2182B", limits = c(-1, 1)) +
  facet_wrap(~method, nrow = 1) +
  coord_fixed() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Correlation", title = "Municipal covariate correlations") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
print(p)
ggsave(file.path(path, "covariate_correlations.png"), p, width = 16, height = 9)
write.csv(correlations, file.path(path, "data/processed/covariate_correlations.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

# Queen-contiguity graph

```{r queen-adjacency, fig.width=9, fig.height=7}
library(spdep)

graph_map <- st_transform(map, 31983)
nb <- poly2nb(graph_map, queen = TRUE, row.names = codes)
xy <- st_coordinates(st_point_on_surface(st_geometry(graph_map)))
nb2INLA(file.path(path, "data/processed/queen.graph"), nb)
links <- nb2lines(nb, coords = xy, proj4string = st_crs(graph_map), as_sf = TRUE)
links <- st_transform(links, 4326)
points <- st_transform(st_as_sf(data.frame(x = xy[, 1], y = xy[, 2]),
                                coords = c("x", "y"), crs = 31983), 4326)

adjacency_map <- leaflet(map_web, width = 1200, height = 1000,
  options = leafletOptions(zoomControl = FALSE, zoomSnap = 0.1)) |>
  addTiles() |>
  fitBounds(bounds[["xmin"]] - 0.3, bounds[["ymin"]] - 0.3,
            bounds[["xmax"]] + 1.5, bounds[["ymax"]] + 0.3) |>
  addPolygons(fillColor = "white", fillOpacity = 0.6, color = "#888888", weight = 0.5) |>
  addPolylines(data = links, color = "#294563", weight = 1, opacity = 0.8) |>
  addCircleMarkers(data = points, radius = 2, color = "#294563", stroke = FALSE, fillOpacity = 1) |>
  addControl("<b style='font-size:26px'>Municipal adjacency</b><br>Queen contiguity | Minas Gerais",
             position = "topleft") |>
  addLegend(position = "bottomright", colors = c("#888888", "#294563"),
            labels = c("Municipal boundaries", "Neighbour links"), opacity = 1) |>
  addScaleBar(position = "bottomleft", options = scaleBarOptions(imperial = FALSE))
adjacency_map <- htmlwidgets::prependContent(adjacency_map, map_css)
htmlwidgets::saveWidget(adjacency_map, file.path(maps_dir, "adjacency_osm.html"),
                       selfcontained = FALSE, libdir = "leaflet_libs")
adjacency_map
```

# Joint model data

```{r sensitivity-model-data}
library(INLA)

graph <- inla.read.graph(file.path(path, "data/processed/queen.graph"))
n <- length(codes)
model_data <- merge(sir, scaled, by = "code")
model_data$disease <- factor(model_data$disease, levels = diseases)
model_data$area <- match(model_data$code, codes)
model_data <- model_data[order(model_data$disease, model_data$area), ]
model_data$int_dengue <- as.integer(model_data$disease == "dengue")
model_data$int_chikungunya <- as.integer(model_data$disease == "chikungunya")
model_data$Y_dengue <- ifelse(model_data$int_dengue == 1, model_data$cases, NA)
model_data$Y_chikungunya <- ifelse(model_data$int_chikungunya == 1, model_data$cases, NA)
model_data$b1 <- ifelse(model_data$int_dengue == 1, model_data$area, NA)
model_data$b2 <- ifelse(model_data$int_chikungunya == 1, model_data$area, NA)
model_data$shared <- model_data$b2
write.csv(model_data, file.path(path, "data/processed/model_data.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

# Common model specification and sigma_wider priors

```{r reference-model}
selection_prior <- list(
  prec = list(prior = "pc.prec", param = c(2, 0.01)),
  phi = list(prior = "pc", param = c(0.5, 2/3))
)

selection_base <- cbind(Y_dengue, Y_chikungunya) ~
  -1 + int_dengue + int_chikungunya +
  f(b1, model = "bym2", graph = graph, n = n,
    scale.model = TRUE, constr = TRUE, hyper = selection_prior) +
  f(b2, model = "bym2", graph = graph, n = n,
    scale.model = TRUE, constr = TRUE, hyper = selection_prior) +
  f(shared, copy = "b1",
    hyper = list(beta = list(prior = "normal", param = c(0, 1), fixed = FALSE)))

full_formula <- update(selection_base,
  paste(". ~ . +", paste(paste0("z_", variables), collapse = " + ")))
```

# Model selection: correlation screening and six candidates

```{r correlation-screening-six-models, eval=FALSE}
vars <- c(
  "z_tempmin_mean", "z_umidmax_mean", "z_log_population_density",
  "z_rainfall_mm", "z_idhm_2010", "z_vegetation_2017",
  "z_no_piped_water_2022", "z_no_sewer_2022",
  "z_no_waste_collection_2022", "z_rural_pct_2022"
)

correlation <- cor(scaled[vars], method = "pearson")
pairs <- which(
  abs(correlation) >= 0.7 & upper.tri(correlation),
  arr.ind = TRUE
)

print(data.frame(
  variable_1 = rownames(correlation)[pairs[, 1]],
  variable_2 = colnames(correlation)[pairs[, 2]],
  correlation = correlation[pairs]
), row.names = FALSE)

common <- c(
  "z_umidmax_mean", "z_log_population_density",
  "z_vegetation_2017", "z_no_piped_water_2022"
)

candidates <- list(
  temp_idhm_rural = c(
    "z_tempmin_mean", "z_idhm_2010", "z_rural_pct_2022"
  ),
  temp_idhm_sewer = c(
    "z_tempmin_mean", "z_idhm_2010", "z_no_sewer_2022"
  ),
  temp_waste_sewer = c(
    "z_tempmin_mean", "z_no_waste_collection_2022", "z_no_sewer_2022"
  ),
  rain_idhm_rural = c(
    "z_rainfall_mm", "z_idhm_2010", "z_rural_pct_2022"
  ),
  rain_idhm_sewer = c(
    "z_rainfall_mm", "z_idhm_2010", "z_no_sewer_2022"
  ),
  rain_waste_sewer = c(
    "z_rainfall_mm", "z_no_waste_collection_2022", "z_no_sewer_2022"
  )
)

waic_comparison <- data.frame()
best_waic <- Inf

for (candidate in names(candidates)) {
  terms <- paste(c(common, candidates[[candidate]]), collapse = " + ")
  selection_formula <- update(selection_base, paste(". ~ . +", terms))

  fit <- inla(
    selection_formula,
    family = c("poisson", "poisson"),
    data = model_data,
    E = model_data$E,
    control.fixed = list(
      mean = 0,
      prec = list(
        default = 1,
        int_dengue = 1/2.5^2,
        int_chikungunya = 1/2.5^2
      )
    ),
    control.compute = list(waic = TRUE)
  )

  waic_comparison <- rbind(
    waic_comparison,
    data.frame(
      model = candidate,
      covariates = terms,
      WAIC = fit$waic$waic
    )
  )

  if (fit$waic$waic < best_waic) {
    best_waic <- fit$waic$waic
    best_fit <- fit
    best_formula <- selection_formula
    selected_vars <- c(common, candidates[[candidate]])
  }
}

waic_comparison <- waic_comparison[order(waic_comparison$WAIC), ]
rownames(waic_comparison) <- NULL
waic_comparison$delta_WAIC <- waic_comparison$WAIC - best_waic

print(waic_comparison[c("model", "WAIC", "delta_WAIC")],
      row.names = FALSE)

print(waic_comparison[1, ], row.names = FALSE)
selected_vars
retained_vars <- selected_vars
candidate_fit <- best_fit
candidate_formula <- best_formula
```

# Model selection: all 128 subsets of the seven covariates

```{r seven-covariate-128-subsets, eval=FALSE}
library(combinat)

vars <- c(
  "z_umidmax_mean", "z_log_population_density",
  "z_vegetation_2017", "z_no_piped_water_2022",
  "z_rainfall_mm", "z_idhm_2010", "z_no_sewer_2022"
)

subsets <- list(character(0))
for (k in seq_along(vars)) {
  subsets <- c(subsets, combinat::combn(vars, k, simplify = FALSE))
}

selection_prior <- list(
  prec = list(prior = "pc.prec", param = c(2, 0.01)),
  phi = list(prior = "pc", param = c(0.5, 2/3))
)

base_formula <- cbind(Y_dengue, Y_chikungunya) ~
  -1 + int_dengue + int_chikungunya +
  f(b1, model = "bym2", graph = graph, n = n,
    scale.model = TRUE, constr = TRUE, hyper = selection_prior) +
  f(b2, model = "bym2", graph = graph, n = n,
    scale.model = TRUE, constr = TRUE, hyper = selection_prior) +
  f(shared, copy = "b1",
    hyper = list(beta = list(prior = "normal", param = c(0, 1), fixed = FALSE)))

subset_comparison <- data.frame()
best_waic <- Inf

for (i in seq_along(subsets)) {
  formula <- base_formula
  terms <- "None"

  if (length(subsets[[i]]) > 0) {
    terms <- paste(subsets[[i]], collapse = " + ")
    formula <- update(base_formula, paste(". ~ . +", terms))
  }

  cat("Fitting model", i, "of", length(subsets), ":", terms, "\n")

  fit <- inla(
    formula,
    family = c("poisson", "poisson"),
    data = model_data,
    E = model_data$E,
    control.fixed = list(
      mean = 0,
      prec = list(
        default = 1,
        int_dengue = 1/2.5^2,
        int_chikungunya = 1/2.5^2
      )
    ),
    control.compute = list(waic = TRUE)
  )

  subset_comparison <- rbind(
    subset_comparison,
    data.frame(
      model = i,
      n_covariates = length(subsets[[i]]),
      covariates = terms,
      WAIC = fit$waic$waic
    )
  )

  cat("WAIC:", fit$waic$waic, "\n")

  if (fit$waic$waic < best_waic) {
    best_waic <- fit$waic$waic
    best_fit <- fit
    best_formula <- formula
    selected_vars <- subsets[[i]]
  }
}

subset_comparison <- subset_comparison[order(subset_comparison$WAIC), ]
rownames(subset_comparison) <- NULL
subset_comparison$delta_WAIC <- subset_comparison$WAIC - best_waic

print(subset_comparison, row.names = FALSE, max = nrow(subset_comparison) * ncol(subset_comparison))

print(subset_comparison[1, ], row.names = FALSE)
best_formula
best_fit$summary.fixed
best_fit$summary.hyperpar

save(subset_comparison, best_formula, selected_vars, model_data,
     graph, n, codes, selection_prior, file = "subset_run_backup.RData")
```

```{r selected-random-effect-maps, eval=FALSE}
effect_maps <- list()
for (j in seq_along(fields)) {
```

# Prior sensitivity: full ten-covariate model

## Prior scenarios

```{r prior-scenarios}
scenarios <- data.frame(
  scenario = c("reference", "phi_balanced", "phi_spatial", "phi_uniform", "sigma_tighter", "sigma_wider"),
  sigma_u = c(1, 1, 1, 1, 0.5, 2),
  sigma_alpha = 0.01,
  phi_prior = c("pc", "pc", "pc", "uniform", "pc", "pc"),
  phi_u = 0.5,
  phi_alpha = c(2/3, 0.5, 0.1, NA, 2/3, 2/3)
)
knitr::kable(scenarios, digits = 3)
sensitivity_dir <- file.path(path, "results/vegetation_water_sewage_waste_rural_2022")
dir.create(sensitivity_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
write.csv(scenarios, file.path(sensitivity_dir, "prior_scenarios.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

## Fit the six scenarios

```{r fit-prior-scenarios}
for (i in seq_len(nrow(scenarios))) {
  prior <- list(
    prec = list(prior = "pc.prec", param = c(scenarios$sigma_u[i], scenarios$sigma_alpha[i])),
    phi = list(prior = "pc", param = c(scenarios$phi_u[i], scenarios$phi_alpha[i]))
  )
  if (scenarios$phi_prior[i] == "uniform") {
    prior$phi <- list(prior = "logitbeta", param = c(1, 1))
  }

  formula <- cbind(Y_dengue, Y_chikungunya) ~ -1 + int_dengue + int_chikungunya +
    z_tempmin_mean + z_umidmax_mean + z_log_population_density + z_rainfall_mm + z_idhm_2010 +
    z_vegetation_2017 + z_no_piped_water_2022 + z_no_sewer_2022 +
    z_no_waste_collection_2022 + z_rural_pct_2022 +
    f(b1, model = "bym2", graph = graph, n = n, scale.model = TRUE, constr = TRUE, hyper = prior) +
    f(b2, model = "bym2", graph = graph, n = n, scale.model = TRUE, constr = TRUE, hyper = prior) +
    f(shared, copy = "b1", hyper = list(beta = list(prior = "normal", param = c(0, 1), fixed = FALSE)))

  fit <- inla(formula, family = c("poisson", "poisson"), data = model_data, E = model_data$E,
              control.fixed = list(mean = 0, prec = list(default = 1,
                int_dengue = 1/2.5^2, int_chikungunya = 1/2.5^2)),
              control.predictor = list(compute = TRUE),
              control.compute = list(dic = TRUE, waic = TRUE))
  saveRDS(fit, file.path(sensitivity_dir, paste0(scenarios$scenario[i], "_fit.rds")))
}
```

## Compare predictive fit and posterior estimates

```{r prior-comparison}
comparison <- fixed <- hyper <- risks <- data.frame()
for (scenario in scenarios$scenario) {
  fit <- readRDS(file.path(sensitivity_dir, paste0(scenario, "_fit.rds")))
  comparison <- rbind(comparison, data.frame(scenario = scenario,
    WAIC = fit$waic$waic, DIC = fit$dic$dic, mode_status = fit$mode$mode.status))
  fixed <- rbind(fixed, data.frame(scenario = scenario, parameter = rownames(fit$summary.fixed),
    fit$summary.fixed[c("mean", "sd", "0.025quant", "0.975quant")], row.names = NULL))
  hyper <- rbind(hyper, data.frame(scenario = scenario, parameter = rownames(fit$summary.hyperpar),
    fit$summary.hyperpar[c("mean", "sd", "0.025quant", "0.975quant")], row.names = NULL))
  risks <- rbind(risks, data.frame(scenario = scenario, model_data[c("code", "disease")],
    RR_median = exp(fit$summary.linear.predictor[, "0.5quant"])))
}
names(fixed)[5:6] <- c("lower_95", "upper_95")
names(hyper)[5:6] <- c("lower_95", "upper_95")
comparison$delta_WAIC <- comparison$WAIC - min(comparison$WAIC)
comparison <- comparison[order(comparison$WAIC), ]
write.csv(comparison, file.path(sensitivity_dir, "prior_comparison.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(fixed, file.path(sensitivity_dir, "fixed_effects.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(hyper, file.path(sensitivity_dir, "hyperparameters.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(risks, file.path(sensitivity_dir, "relative_risks.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
knitr::kable(comparison, digits = 3, row.names = FALSE)
```

# Posterior relative risks

```{r}

library(INLA)

cutoff <- 0.98   # P(RR > 1 | data) > 0.98

final_vars <- c("z_vegetation_2017", "z_rainfall_mm", "z_idhm_2010",
                "z_no_piped_water_2022", "z_no_sewer_2022")
final_formula <- update(selection_base, paste(". ~ . +", paste(final_vars, collapse = " + ")))

fit_file <- file.path(path, "data/processed/final_fit_sampling.rds")
final_fit <- inla(
  final_formula,
  family = c("poisson", "poisson"),
  data = model_data,
  E = model_data$E,
  control.fixed = list(mean = 0, prec = list(default = 1,
                       int_dengue = 1/2.5^2, int_chikungunya = 1/2.5^2)),
  control.predictor = list(compute = TRUE),
  control.compute = list(waic = TRUE, dic = TRUE, return.marginals.predictor = TRUE,
                         config = TRUE)
)
saveRDS(final_fit, fit_file)

eta <- final_fit$summary.linear.predictor
set.seed(123)
samples <- inla.posterior.sample(10000, final_fit, selection = list(Predictor = 0, b1 = seq_len(n), shared = seq_len(n), b2 = seq_len(n)), seed = 123, num.threads = 1)

index <- match(paste0("Predictor:", seq_len(nrow(model_data))),
               rownames(samples[[1]]$latent))
p_above_1 <- numeric(nrow(model_data))
for (i in seq_along(samples)) {
  rr_sample <- exp(samples[[i]]$latent[index, 1])
  p_above_1 <- p_above_1 + (rr_sample > 1)
}
p_above_1 <- p_above_1 / length(samples)

post <- data.frame(
  model_data[c("code", "municipality", "disease", "cases", "E", "SIR")],
  RR = final_fit$summary.fitted.values[, "mean"], lower = exp(eta[, "0.025quant"]), upper = exp(eta[, "0.975quant"]),
  prob_RR_above_1 = p_above_1, row.names = NULL
)
write.csv(post, file.path(path, "data/processed/posterior_relative_risks.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

den  <- post[post$disease == "dengue", ]
chik <- post[post$disease == "chikungunya", ]
stopifnot(nrow(den) == n, identical(den$code, chik$code))

cols <- c("municipality", "cases", "E", "SIR", "RR", "lower", "upper")
top  <- function(x, k = 5) head(x[order(-x$RR), cols], k)
knitr::kable(top(den),  digits = 2, row.names = FALSE,
             caption = "Dengue: five municipalities with the highest model-based relative risks")
knitr::kable(top(chik), digits = 2, row.names = FALSE,
             caption = "Chikungunya: five municipalities with the highest model-based relative risks")

hi_d <- den$prob_RR_above_1 > cutoff
hi_c <- chik$prob_RR_above_1 > cutoff
knitr::kable(data.frame(disease = c("dengue", "chikungunya"),
                        n = c(sum(hi_d), sum(hi_c)),
                        pct = round(100 * c(mean(hi_d), mean(hi_c)), 1)), row.names = FALSE,
             caption = "Municipalities with P(RR > 1 | data) > 0.98, by disease")

both <- hi_d & hi_c
both_tab <- data.frame(municipality = den$municipality, RR_dengue = den$RR,
                       RR_chikungunya = chik$RR)[both, ]
both_tab <- both_tab[order(-pmin(both_tab$RR_dengue, both_tab$RR_chikungunya)), ]
cat("\nMunicipalities meeting the elevated-risk criterion separately for both diseases: count and percentage\n")
c(n = sum(both), pct = round(100 * mean(both), 1))
knitr::kable(head(both_tab, 5), digits = 2, row.names = FALSE,
             caption = "Five municipalities meeting both elevated-risk criteria, ranked by the smaller of their two RRs")

sir_both <- den$SIR > 1 & chik$SIR > 1
cat("\nMunicipalities with raw SIR > 1 for both diseases: count and percentage\n")
c(SIR_above_1_both_n = sum(sir_both), pct = round(100 * mean(sir_both), 1))

by_sir <- function(x, k = 3) head(x[order(-x$SIR), cols], k)   # top SIRs and their smoothed RRs
knitr::kable(by_sir(den),  digits = 2, row.names = FALSE,
             caption = "Dengue: raw SIR and model-based RR in the three municipalities with the highest SIRs")
knitr::kable(by_sir(chik), digits = 2, row.names = FALSE,
             caption = "Chikungunya: raw SIR and model-based RR in the three municipalities with the highest SIRs")

cat("\nSpearman rank correlation between raw SIR and model-based RR, by disease\n")
sapply(list(dengue = den, chikungunya = chik),
       function(x) cor(x$SIR, x$RR, method = "spearman"))

```
## Relative risks for both diseases

```{r selected-rr-maps, eval=FALSE}
rr <- read.csv(file.path(path, "data/processed/posterior_relative_risks.csv"))
rr_maps <- list()
for (disease in diseases) {
  x <- map_web
  rows <- rr[rr$disease == disease, ]
  x$value <- rows$RR[match(x$code_muni, rows$code)]
  p <- leaflet(x, width = 1200, height = 1000,
    options = leafletOptions(zoomControl = FALSE, zoomSnap = 0.1)) |>
    addTiles() |>
    fitBounds(bounds[["xmin"]] - 0.3, bounds[["ymin"]] - 0.3,
              bounds[["xmax"]] + 1.5, bounds[["ymax"]] + 0.3) |>
    addPolygons(fillColor = ~risk_palette(value), fillOpacity = 0.95,
      color = "white", weight = 0.5, opacity = 0.7,
      label = ~paste0(name_muni, ": RR = ", round(value, 2))) |>
    addLegend(position = "bottomright", colors = risk_colors, labels = risk_labels,
      opacity = 0.95, title = "Relative risk") |>
    addControl(paste0("<b style='font-size:26px'>", tools::toTitleCase(disease),
      "</b><br>Posterior mean RR | Minas Gerais, 2021-2025"), position = "topleft") |>
    addScaleBar(position = "bottomleft", options = scaleBarOptions(imperial = FALSE))
  p <- htmlwidgets::prependContent(p, map_css)
  rr_maps[[disease]] <- p
  htmlwidgets::saveWidget(p, file.path(maps_dir, paste0("RR_", disease, "_osm.html")),
                         selfcontained = FALSE, libdir = "leaflet_libs")
}
htmltools::tagList(rr_maps)
```

### Joint exceedance probability map

```{r joint-exceedance-map}
idx_d <- which(model_data$disease == "dengue")
idx_c <- which(model_data$disease == "chikungunya")
idx_c <- idx_c[match(model_data$code[idx_d], model_data$code[idx_c])]

joint_prob <- numeric(length(idx_d))
for (i in seq_along(samples)) {
  rr_d <- exp(samples[[i]]$latent[index[idx_d], 1])
  rr_c <- exp(samples[[i]]$latent[index[idx_c], 1])
  joint_prob <- joint_prob + (rr_d > 1 & rr_c > 1)
}
joint_prob <- joint_prob / length(samples)

x <- map_web
x$probability <- unname(joint_prob[match(as.character(x$code_muni), model_data$code[idx_d])])
x$fill <- unname(ifelse(x$probability > 0.98, "#B62828", "#F7F7F7"))
p <- leaflet(x, width = 1200, height = 1000,
    options = leafletOptions(zoomControl = FALSE, zoomSnap = 0.1)) |>
  addTiles() |>
  fitBounds(bounds[["xmin"]] - 0.3, bounds[["ymin"]] - 0.3,
            bounds[["xmax"]] + 1.5, bounds[["ymax"]] + 0.3) |>
  addPolygons(fillColor = ~fill, fillOpacity = 0.95,
    color = "white", weight = 0.5, opacity = 0.7,
    label = ~paste0(name_muni, ": Joint probability = ",
                    round(100 * probability, 2), "%")) |>
  addLegend(position = "bottomright", colors = c("#B62828", "#F7F7F7"),
    labels = c(">98%", "<=98%"), opacity = 0.95,
    title = "P(both RRs > 1 | data)") |>
  addControl(paste0("<b style='font-size:26px'>Dengue and chikungunya</b>",
      "<br>Joint exceedance probability >98% | Minas Gerais, 2021-2025"),
    position = "topleft") |>
  addScaleBar(position = "bottomleft", options = scaleBarOptions(imperial = FALSE))
p <- htmlwidgets::prependContent(p, map_css)
htmlwidgets::saveWidget(p, file.path(maps_dir, "joint_exceedance_98_osm.html"),
                        selfcontained = FALSE, libdir = "leaflet_libs")
p
```

# correlation between the dengue and chikungunya municipal random effects 
```{r}
labels <- rownames(samples[[1]]$latent)
b1 <- match(paste0("b1:", seq_len(n)), labels)
shared <- match(paste0("shared:", seq_len(n)), labels)
b2 <- match(paste0("b2:", seq_len(n)), labels)

cors <- numeric(length(samples))    # correlation once per posterior draw.
for (i in seq_along(samples)) {
  x <- samples[[i]]$latent[, 1]
  cors[i] <- cor(x[b1], x[shared] + x[b2])
}

mean(cors)  #averages the 10,000 correlations.
quantile(cors, c(0.025, 0.975))   #lower and upper limits of their central 95% credible interval.
```
